title: Ariel
summary: Ariel is a protective, loyal Gaia-Titan with a mastery over the wind and storms. Able to create vortexes of energy from his hands and tornadoes that travel hundreds of kilometers, Ariel is one of the primary Titans of Dante Vale, having been given to him by his mentor, Metz.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Ariel, also known as Uriel, was an archangel found primarily in Judeo-Christian mysticism and in the Apocrypha. Generally presented as an authority over the Earth and its elements, Ariel has also been called an angel of healing, wrath, and creation. 

Ariel was the primary Titan of Metz when he was younger and first starting out as a Huntik Foundation Seeker. Metz used Ariel on his numerous adventures with Eathon Lambert and Simon Judeau. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Metz eventually gave Ariel's Amulet to Dante Vale to help him against the Professor. During their final battle, Dante invoked Ariel alongside Caliban and Ignatius to stop the Professor from using the Legendary Titan of Immortality, Overlos. Ariel helped Gar-Ghoul keep Tao occupied before catching Caliban after he was thrown through the air by Behemoth. However, Tao recovered and sent Ariel back to his Amulet. [The Mission]

In the Paris Catacombs, Dante used Ariel to help him defeat Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate. Ariel turned into a whirlwind and circled Arc to temporarily distract her before flying Dante a few meters up such that he could finish off Arc with his spells from above. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Ariel was invoked by Dante during the battle at the Fortress of Iron Will. While Dante fought Kiel, Ariel fought with Vulcana but was eventually defeated. [The Spiral War]

In Egypt, Ariel was used by Dante outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun on the team's mission The Eye of the Storm to capture Rassimov. Ariel erased the team's footprints before creating a powerful storm that disorientate both Rassimov and Harrison Fears. Later that day, Ariel became Powerbonded to Dante, saving him from Rassimov. After burying Rassimov in sand with his Hyperstrike ability, Dante told Powerbonded Ariel to get the team to safety while he led Legion, the Titan of War, away with the Necklace of Tutankhamun. However, when Solwing independently led the Blood Spiral away with the necklace, Powerbonded Ariel held Dante back and reminded him to help his friends. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E34 Ariel Arc.png|thumb|Ariel distracts [[Arc]]]]
Ariel uses nature and wind-based attacks to attack enemies at a distance, and in doing so, has been known to conjure up leaf storms to distract and disorient any threats. {{source|Huntik.com}} Ariel can fly at great speed and become a circular whirlwind to dazzle his enemies. {{source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}} He can also fire tornado blasts from his hands that heavily knockback and damage those hit {{Source|The Spiral War}}, and is strong enough to carry people {{Source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}} and [[Titans]] such as [[Caliban]] {{Source|The Mission}}, allowing [[Seekers]] to attack from above. His mastery of the elements, particularly the wind, means he is able to erase footprints in sand by creating controlled small-scale tornados, or completely disorient and hinder the vision of multiple people with a larger tornado {{Source|Rassimov's Secret}}. Ariel also has good overall awareness of his surroundings when fighting and can quickly aid allies when they are in need of help. {{Source|The Mission}} However, he is not very durable and will get sent back to his amulet after hit by a single of [[Vulcana]]'s fireballs. {{Source|The Spiral War}}

When the bond with Dante became stronger, Ariel became Powerbonded, gaining a larger cape, with vines and branches extending out from his body. He is now able to create more offensive tornadoes with increased range and magnitude. 

*Hyperstrike - this ability allows Ariel to create whirlwinds around his Seeker's legs while also creating a tornado underneath himself, enabling them to levitate through the air at speed whilst creating violent tornadoes that repel anything in their path. These are powerful enough to bury enemy Seekers in a sand dune. [Rassimov's Secret]

Ariel's telepathic link with Dante also strengthened considerably, allowing him to advise Dante and hold him back from going after Rassimov, instead reminding him to get his team to safety. [Rassimov's Secret]
